name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of Rs 6000 per year to small and marginal farmers to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities.
eligibility: All land holding farmers families with cultivable land. Small and marginal farmers with combined land holding up to 2 hectares. Family means husband, wife and minor children. Must be Indian citizen. Farmers with institutional land holdings and constitutional post holders are excluded.
benefits: Rs 6000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2000 each directly transferred to bank account via DBT every 4 months.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit PM-KISAN portal pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Click on Farmers Corner and select New Farmer Registration. 3. Enter Aadhaar number, bank account details and land records. 4. Submit application and get registration number. 5. Alternatively apply through local Patwari or Agriculture office.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account passbook, Land ownership records (Khatauni/Jamabandi), Mobile number linked to Aadhaar

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to financial services namely, Banking, Savings and Deposit Accounts, Remittance, Credit, Insurance, Pension in an affordable manner.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age. No minimum balance required. Can be opened with zero balance. Priority to unbanked adults especially in rural areas.
benefits: Zero balance savings account, RuPay debit card, accidental insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh, life cover of Rs 30000, overdraft facility up to Rs 10000 after 6 months of satisfactory operation.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Mitra). 2. Fill account opening form. 3. Submit KYC documents. 4. Account opened on same day. 5. Get passbook and RuPay card.
documents: Aadhaar card (or any one of: Voter ID, Driving License, NREGA job card, PAN card), passport-sized photographs

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Housing scheme to provide pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas by 2024.
eligibility: Households who are homeless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses as per SECC 2011 data. SC/ST, minorities, freed bonded labourers, families of widows and ex-servicemen given priority. Annual income below Rs 3 lakh.
benefits: Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas as house construction assistance. Rs 12000 for construction of toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission. 90 days MGNREGS wages for unskilled labour.
how_to_apply: 1. Beneficiary list prepared from SECC 2011 data by Gram Panchayat. 2. Gram Sabha verification of list. 3. Selected beneficiaries register on Awaas App or AwaasSoft portal. 4. Bank account and Aadhaar mandatory for DBT. 5. Money released in installments based on construction progress.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account linked to Aadhaar, SECC 2011 inclusion proof, Caste certificate (if SC/ST), Land ownership proof

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing for All mission in urban areas to provide affordable housing to urban poor including slum dwellers.
eligibility: EWS: Annual household income up to Rs 3 lakh. LIG: Income Rs 3-6 lakh. MIG-I: Income Rs 6-12 lakh. MIG-II: Income Rs 12-18 lakh. Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India. First time home buyers preferred.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans: EWS/LIG: 6.5% on loan up to Rs 6 lakh for 20 years. MIG-I: 4% on Rs 9 lakh. MIG-II: 3% on Rs 12 lakh. In-situ slum rehabilitation: free house in some cases.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at Common Service Centres or at housing.gov.in. 2. Select city and housing scheme. 3. Fill application with income and household details. 4. For credit linked subsidy: apply through registered banks and HFCs. 5. Subsidy credited directly to loan account.
documents: Aadhaar card, Income certificate, Bank account details, Property documents if applicable, Caste certificate if applicable

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing free secondary and tertiary healthcare to poor and vulnerable families at empanelled hospitals across India.
eligibility: Families covered under SECC 2011 database. Automatically identified based on deprivation criteria. No income limit separately - based on SECC data. Covers entire family with no cap on family size or age. About 10.74 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 50 crore beneficiaries).
benefits: Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. Covers pre-existing diseases from day one. Cashless and paperless treatment at 25000+ empanelled hospitals. Covers 1929 medical procedures including surgeries.
how_to_apply: 1. Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555 helpline. 2. If eligible, get Ayushman card from nearest CSC or empanelled hospital. 3. Show Aadhaar or ration card at hospital for treatment. 4. Treatment is fully cashless at empanelled hospitals.
documents: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Mobile number. No application needed - automatically covered if in SECC 2011.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Must be resident of the area. No income or caste criteria. Household means persons normally living and eating together.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year per household. Wages paid at state-notified rates (around Rs 200-350 per day depending on state). If work not provided within 15 days, unemployment allowance paid. Work provided within 5km of residence. Women guaranteed at least 33% of works.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply for job card at Gram Panchayat office. 2. Submit household details and photo. 3. Job card issued within 15 days. 4. Submit written application for work to Gram Panchayat. 5. Work must be allotted within 15 days.
documents: Aadhaar card or Voter ID, Photograph, Proof of residence (ration card or electricity bill)

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Scheme to provide free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line households to replace traditional chulha and protect health of rural women.
eligibility: Women above 18 years from BPL households. Priority to SC/ST households, PMAY beneficiaries, Antyodaya Anna Yojana beneficiaries, forest dwellers, most backward classes, tea garden workers. Must not have existing LPG connection in the household. SECC 2011 list or state BPL list.
benefits: Free LPG connection including security deposit waiver, regulator and gas hose. First refill free. Option for EMI for stove and first refill through loan deducted from future refill subsidies.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit nearest LPG distributor (IndianOil, BPCL, HPCL). 2. Fill KYC form (available at distributor or pmuy.gov.in). 3. Submit documents proving BPL status. 4. Connection given at no cost to eligible beneficiary.
documents: Aadhaar card, BPL card or ration card, Bank account details, Recent passport-sized photo, Self-declaration of no existing LPG connection

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentive to pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child to compensate for wage loss and improve health practices.
eligibility: All pregnant and lactating women for first living child. Age 19 years and above. Employees of central/state government or PSUs excluded as they get paid maternity leave. Applicable for miscarriage/stillbirth with restart of conditions from next pregnancy.
benefits: Rs 5000 in three installments: Rs 1000 at early registration of pregnancy, Rs 2000 after 6 months with at least one ANC, Rs 2000 after child birth registration and completion of first cycle of vaccination. Additional Rs 1000 at institution delivery under JSY.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or government health centre within 150 days of last menstrual period. 2. Fill Form 1A with Aadhaar and bank details. 3. Subsequent installments claimed with respective forms. 4. All cash transferred directly to beneficiary's bank account.
documents: Aadhaar card of mother and husband, Bank passbook, MCP card (Mother and Child Protection card), Proof of pregnancy

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Pension scheme focused on unorganised sector workers providing guaranteed pension of Rs 1000-5000 per month after age 60.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-40 years. Must have savings bank account or post office savings account. Should not be an income tax payer. Not covered under any statutory social security scheme. Workers in unorganised sector.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 or 5000 per month after age 60 based on contribution amount. Same pension to spouse after subscriber's death. Return of corpus to nominee after spouse's death. Government co-contributed 50% or Rs 1000 per year for 5 years for accounts opened before March 2016.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit any bank branch or post office with savings account. 2. Fill APY application form. 3. Provide Aadhaar and mobile number. 4. Auto-debit set up from savings account. 5. Can also apply through net banking or mobile banking of most banks.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account passbook, Mobile number

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme offering renewable one-year life cover for death due to any reason at very low premium.
eligibility: Age 18-50 years. Must have a bank account. Aadhaar primary KYC for the bank account. Available through all banks including payment banks.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh life insurance coverage for death from any cause. Annual premium of only Rs 436 (auto-debited from bank). Coverage from June 1 to May 31. Renewable annually.
how_to_apply: 1. Contact your bank branch, net banking, or mobile banking. 2. Fill simple consent form. 3. Auto-debit mandate given for Rs 436 annually. 4. Coverage starts immediately. 5. Can also enroll through Jan Dhan account.
documents: Bank account, Aadhaar card, Mobile number

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accidental insurance scheme offering coverage for death or disability due to accident at very low premium of Rs 20 per year.
eligibility: Age 18-70 years. Must have a bank account. Active mobile number linked to bank account. Aadhaar KYC for the bank account.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death and permanent total disability. Rs 1 lakh for permanent partial disability. Annual premium only Rs 20. Coverage from June 1 to May 31.
how_to_apply: 1. Enroll through bank branch, net banking, mobile banking, or SMS. 2. Simple one-page consent form. 3. Rs 20 auto-debited from bank account annually. 4. Immediate coverage.
documents: Bank account, Aadhaar card

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension to old aged persons living below poverty line who have little or no regular means of subsistence.
eligibility: Age 60-79 years: Rs 200/month pension. Age 80 and above: Rs 500/month. Must be Below Poverty Line (BPL). No regular means of support from own sources or family members.
benefits: Rs 200 per month for ages 60-79. Rs 500 per month for ages 80+. States add additional top-up (varies by state - some pay Rs 1000-2000 total). Direct bank transfer.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at Gram Panchayat or Ward office. 2. Fill NSAP application form. 3. Panchayat verifies and forwards to District authority. 4. Social audit done. 5. Pension starts after verification.
documents: Age proof (birth certificate, school certificate, or medical certificate), BPL card or ration card, Bank account details, Aadhaar card, Passport photograph

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Campaign to address declining Child Sex Ratio and related issues of women empowerment through education and awareness.
eligibility: Girl children especially in districts with low sex ratio. Primarily awareness campaign. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is the financial component for girl child savings.
benefits: Awareness and advocacy. Improved access to education for girls. Sukanya Samriddhi Account: 7.6% interest (tax free), Rs 250 minimum deposit, up to Rs 1.5 lakh annually, account matures when girl turns 21, partial withdrawal at 18 for education/marriage.
how_to_apply: Open Sukanya Samriddhi Account at any post office or authorized bank branch for girl child below 10 years. Parents/guardians can open account.
documents: Girl child's birth certificate, ID proof of parent/guardian, Address proof, Photo of parent/guardian

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Micro finance scheme providing loans up to Rs 10 lakh to non-corporate non-farm small/micro enterprises to start or expand business.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen planning to start or expand small/micro business in manufacturing, trading, service sector. Non-farm activities. No minimum income requirement. No collateral required. Women entrepreneurs, SC/ST, OBC preferred.
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to Rs 50000 for startup/new business. Kishor: Loans Rs 50001-5 lakh for established business needing expansion. Tarun: Loans Rs 5-10 lakh for well-established businesses. No collateral. Mudra card for working capital.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit any PSB bank, regional rural bank, microfinance institution, NBFC. 2. Fill Mudra loan application form (available at mudra.org.in). 3. Submit business plan and documents. 4. Bank assesses and sanctions loan. 5. No guarantee required.
documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Bank statement (6 months), Business proof or plan, Address proof, 2 passport photos, Caste certificate if applicable

name: Stand Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
eligibility: SC or ST borrowers, or Women entrepreneurs. Age 18 years and above. Setting up a greenfield enterprise (first time). Enterprise can be manufacturing, services, or trading sector. Borrower not in default to any bank or financial institution.
benefits: Composite loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore covering 75% of project cost. Loan tenor up to 7 years. Working capital component through cash credit. Rupay debit card for working capital. No collateral beyond primary security.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online at standupmitra.in. 2. Fill application with business plan. 3. Connect with bank branch assigned. 4. Submit documents and business plan. 5. Bank sanctions loan.
documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Detailed business plan, 6-month bank statement, Proof of SC/ST status or being a woman, Property documents if any

name: National Scholarship Portal - Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship to SC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to complete their education.
eligibility: Students belonging to Scheduled Caste. Studying in Class 11 and above. Parental income not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh per annum. Must be studying in a government or recognized institution.
benefits: Maintenance allowance: Rs 380-1200 per month depending on course level. Study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges, reader charges for blind students. Course fees reimbursed. Book allowance for distance education.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal). 2. Fill application form online. 3. Upload required documents. 4. Submit before deadline (usually July-October). 5. Institute verifies application. 6. Scholarship credited to bank account.
documents: Caste certificate (SC), Income certificate, Mark sheets of previous exam, Bank account details, Aadhaar card, Current admission proof, Fee receipt

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students
description: Fellowship to ST students pursuing MPhil and PhD degrees to promote higher education among tribal communities.
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe. Registered in MPhil or PhD programme at recognised university. Age below 40 years for JRF and below 45 for SRF. Must qualify NET/SLET or be enrolled with university directly.
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF): Rs 31000 per month for first 2 years. Senior Research Fellowship (SRF): Rs 35000 per month for next 3 years. HRA as per institution norms. Contingency grant Rs 10000/year for JRF and Rs 20500/year for SRF.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online at tribal.nic.in when notification released. 2. Fill application with academic details. 3. Submit documents. 4. Merit-based selection. 5. 667 fellowships available per year.
documents: ST certificate, NET/SLET score card if applicable, Enrolment proof in MPhil/PhD, Mark sheets, Aadhaar card, Bank details

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Flagship scheme for skill training of youth to enable them to secure livelihood through short-duration skill training and recognition of prior learning.
eligibility: Indian nationals. Unemployed or school/college dropouts. Age 15-45 years broadly. No income criteria. Priority to youth in need of skill training. Short term training: 150-300 hours. RPL for experienced workers.
benefits: Free skill training from certified training centres. Training in 500+ job roles across 40+ sectors. Certificate from NSDC recognized and accepted nationally. Post-training placement assistance. Monetary reward of Rs 8000 on completion and assessment. Stipend during training.
how_to_apply: 1. Find nearest PMKVY training centre at pmkvyofficial.org. 2. Or call toll-free 08800055555. 3. Register at training centre with basic documents. 4. Choose sector and job role. 5. Complete training and assessment. 6. Get certificate and placement support.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account, Educational certificates, Passport-sized photographs

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Provides free food grains to the poorest of poor families to ensure no one goes hungry.
eligibility: Beneficiaries under National Food Security Act (NFSA). Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families and Priority Households. Covered under ration card system. About 81 crore beneficiaries.
benefits: 5 kg of free wheat/rice per person per month under NFSA in addition to highly subsidised 35kg for AAY families. Distributed through PDS ration shops. One Nation One Ration Card - can avail from any ration shop in India.
how_to_apply: 1. Enroll in National Food Security Act through state government. 2. Get ration card from local food office or CSC. 3. Ration distributed monthly at nearest Fair Price Shop. 4. Show ration card and Aadhaar for biometric authentication.
documents: Aadhaar card, Existing ration card if any, Income proof, Address proof, Family photo

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for parents to build corpus for girl child's education and marriage expenses with high interest rate and tax benefits.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardian of girl child. Girl must be below 10 years of age at account opening. One account per girl child. Maximum 2 accounts per family (or 3 if twins/triplets). Must be Indian citizen.
benefits: Interest rate 7.6% per annum (revised quarterly, currently highest among small savings schemes). Tax deduction under Section 80C up to Rs 1.5 lakh. Interest earned is tax free. Maturity amount tax free. Account matures when girl turns 21. Partial withdrawal up to 50% after girl turns 18 for education.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit any Post Office or authorised bank (SBI, PNB, Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, etc.). 2. Fill account opening form. 3. Initial deposit minimum Rs 250. 4. Passbook issued. 5. Deposit minimum Rs 250 per year, maximum Rs 1.5 lakh per year.
documents: Girl child's birth certificate, Parent/guardian ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, passport), Address proof, Photo of parent and child

name: PM SVANidhi - PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme for street vendors to resume livelihoods affected by COVID-19 pandemic with collateral-free working capital loans.
eligibility: Street vendors operating in urban areas. Must have Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body or Certificate of Vending from Town Vending Committee. Vendors who were vending on or before March 24, 2020.
benefits: Initial collateral-free loan of Rs 10000. On timely repayment eligible for Rs 20000, then Rs 50000. Annual interest subsidy of 7% credited quarterly. Digital transactions incentive up to Rs 1200 per year. No collateral required.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest bank/MFI/NBFC. 2. Get LoR from ULB (Urban Local Body/municipality). 3. Fill loan application. 4. Verify at nearest bank branch. 5. Loan disbursed to bank account.
documents: Aadhaar card, Certificate of Vending or LoR from municipality, Bank account details, Photograph

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers when crops are damaged by natural calamities, pests or diseases.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Compulsory for farmers with KCC (Kisan Credit Card) loans. Voluntary for others. All crops: food crops, oilseeds, annual commercial/horticulture crops.
benefits: Maximum premium 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for annual commercial/horticulture crops. Government pays remaining premium. Full sum insured compensated for total crop loss. Technology-based quick claims settlement. Coverage from sowing to post-harvest.
how_to_apply: 1. Enroll at nearest bank branch, CSC or Insurance company office before cut-off date. 2. Or apply at pmfby.gov.in. 3. Pay premium amount. 4. In case of crop loss, intimate nearest bank/insurance company/CSC within 72 hours of event. 5. Claim assessed and settled within 2 months.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account, Land records (Khasra/Patwari number), Sowing certificate, Premium payment receipt

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Credit card scheme for farmers to provide adequate and timely credit for agricultural and non-farm activities at concessional interest rates.
eligibility: All farmers individual or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators. Tenant farmers, oral lessees, share croppers. Self Help Groups of farmers. Fishermen, animal husbandry farmers also eligible. Short term credit needs.
benefits: Revolving credit for agricultural needs. Interest rate 9% reduced to 4-7% with interest subvention for timely repayment. Credit limit based on land holding and crop pattern. ATM card for withdrawal. Insurance coverage under PMFBY. Limit revised every 5 years.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit nearest bank branch (SBI, cooperative banks, regional rural banks). 2. Fill KCC application form. 3. Submit land and farm documents. 4. Bank assesses credit limit based on land. 5. KCC issued within 2 weeks.
documents: Land records, Aadhaar card, Passport photograph, Bank account details, Proof of farming activity

name: National Health Mission (NHM) - Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Safe motherhood intervention scheme promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
eligibility: All pregnant women who deliver in government health institutions. Priority to BPL women, SC/ST women, and women aged below 19 years. No restriction on number of children for government institution deliveries.
benefits: In Low Performing States (LPS - mostly North India/rural): Rs 1400 for rural delivery, Rs 1000 for urban delivery. High Performing States (HPS - mostly South India): Rs 700 for rural, Rs 600 for urban. Additional ASHA incentive of Rs 600 in LPS. Free delivery in government hospital.
how_to_apply: 1. Register pregnancy at nearest ASHA worker or Sub Centre. 2. Attend antenatal check-ups. 3. Deliver at government hospital. 4. Cash received within 7 days of discharge. 5. ASHA accompanies to hospital and receives incentive.
documents: Aadhaar card, BPL card if available, Bank account details, JSY card issued during ANC registration, ASHA's record

name: Mid Day Meal Scheme (PM POSHAN)
description: School lunch programme providing hot cooked meals to children in government schools to improve nutritional status and increase school attendance.
eligibility: Children studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools, government-aided schools, and special training centres. All children automatically eligible - no application required.
benefits: Free hot cooked meal every school day. Caloric content: 450 calories and 12g protein for primary (1-5), 700 calories and 20g protein for upper primary (6-8). Helps prevent hunger and malnutrition among school children.
how_to_apply: No application needed. All enrolled children in government schools automatically receive meals. Parents should ensure children are enrolled in government school.
documents: No documents needed - automatic for enrolled students

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan - Free Textbooks and Uniforms
description: Comprehensive programme for school education providing free textbooks and uniforms to girls and SC/ST students to reduce financial burden.
eligibility: All girls studying in Classes 1-8 in government schools. SC/ST boys in Classes 1-8. Children with disabilities in Classes 1-12. State-specific eligibility may vary.
benefits: Free textbooks to all students. Free uniforms (2 sets per year) to girls (Class 1-8), SC/ST boys (Class 1-8). Free uniforms to children with disabilities (Class 1-12). Scholarship support for meritorious children from disadvantaged groups.
how_to_apply: No application required. Automatically provided to eligible students at school. Parents should enroll children in government schools. Contact headmaster/teacher for any issues.
documents: Caste certificate for SC/ST boys, Disability certificate if applicable, School enrollment

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
description: Apprenticeship training for diploma and degree holders to acquire practical skills and knowledge for industry requirements.
eligibility: Graduates and diploma holders from all streams. Age 16 and above. Must be Indian national. Unemployed or fresher graduates seeking practical training. Not currently employed.
benefits: Stipend: Graduate apprentice Rs 9000/month, Technician apprentice Rs 8050/month, Vocational certificate Rs 7700/month. Practical industry experience with reputed companies. Certificate valid for life. 50% of stipend borne by Government.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at mhrdnats.gov.in. 2. Search for apprenticeship opportunities by location and sector. 3. Apply to companies. 4. Get selected and sign apprenticeship contract. 5. Training for 6-24 months.
documents: Degree/diploma certificates, Aadhaar card, Bank account, Passport photograph, Resume

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Scheme to support artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades with credit, skill training and market support.
eligibility: Workers engaged in one of 18 trades: carpenter, boat maker, armourer, blacksmith, hammer and tool kit maker, locksmith, goldsmith, potter, sculptor, cobbler, mason, basket/mat/broom/coir weaver, doll and toy maker, barber, garland maker, washerman, tailor, fishing net maker. Age 18-60. Not a government employee or income tax payer.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate. Credit support: Rs 1 lakh (first tranche) and Rs 2 lakh (second tranche) at 5% interest rate. Skill training: 5-15 days basic + 15 days advanced. Toolkit incentive Rs 15000. Digital transaction incentive Rs 1 per transaction up to 100 per month. Market linkage support.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in through CSC. 2. Mobile verification and self-declaration. 3. Village level verification by Gram Panchayat. 4. District level verification. 5. Enroll in skill training. 6. Credit through bank.
documents: Aadhaar card, Mobile linked to Aadhaar, Bank account, Ration card (for family verification), Trade skill proof (if any)

name: eShram Portal - Unorganised Workers Registration
description: National database of unorganised workers to deliver social security benefits to gig workers, construction workers, agricultural workers, domestic workers and others.
eligibility: Workers in unorganised sector aged 16-59 years. Not a member of EPFO or ESIC (meaning not in formal employment). Agricultural workers, construction workers, domestic workers, drivers, street vendors, hawkers, fishermen, weavers, garment workers, all informal workers.
benefits: eShram card (UAN number). Accident insurance under PMSBY: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death, Rs 1 lakh for partial disability (premium paid by government). Priority in all social security schemes. Database to receive direct benefits from government.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC. 2. Enter Aadhaar and mobile number. 3. Fill occupation and bank details. 4. OTP verification. 5. eShram card downloaded immediately. Very simple process - under 5 minutes.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account, Mobile number linked to Aadhaar

name: PM CARE for Children
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Support scheme for children who lost both parents or legal guardians due to COVID-19 to ensure their well-being and future.
eligibility: Children who lost both parents or surviving parent or legal guardian due to COVID-19 between March 11, 2020 and February 28, 2022. Age up to 18 years at time of application. Indian citizen.
benefits: Rs 10 lakh corpus in PM CARES fund on child reaching 18 years. Health insurance under Ayushman Bharat. Tuition fee for classes 1-12, then college fees or vocational course fees. Monthly stipend of Rs 4000 from age 18-23 years during higher education.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at pmcaresforchildren.in within prescribed deadline. 2. Register with district magistrate. 3. Submit death certificates and relationship proof. 4. DM verifies and recommends. 5. Benefits start immediately.
documents: Death certificates of both parents, Birth certificate of child, Relationship proof, Bank account (child/guardian), Aadhaar card

name: National Means cum Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship to meritorious students from economically weaker section to arrest dropout at Class 8 and encourage to continue secondary and higher secondary education.
eligibility: Students of Class 9-12 in government/government-aided schools. Parental income not exceeding Rs 3.5 lakh per annum. Must have cleared Class 7 with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST). Must pass NMMS examination conducted by state.
benefits: Rs 12000 per year (Rs 1000 per month) for Classes 9-12. Directly transferred to bank account. No bond or service requirement.
how_to_apply: 1. Appear for state-level NMMS examination in Class 8. 2. If selected, apply at scholarships.gov.in. 3. Submit income certificate and mark sheets. 4. Annual renewal required with passing marks.
documents: Aadhaar card, Income certificate, Class 7 and 8 mark sheets, Caste certificate if SC/ST, Bank account details, School enrollment proof

name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Free coaching for SC and OBC students for competitive examinations like UPSC, SSC, RRB, banking, NEET, JEE, CAT.
eligibility: SC students: family income not exceeding Rs 8 lakh per annum. OBC students: family income not exceeding Rs 8 lakh per annum. Age below 30 years for group A exams, 28 for group B. Already passed qualifying exams for respective competitive exams.
benefits: Free coaching at premier coaching institutes. Stipend Rs 3000 per month for residential students and Rs 1500 for day scholars. Course fee paid by government. One chance per level of examination.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online at coaching.dosje.gov.in during application period. 2. Select exam type and preferred coaching centre. 3. Submit income and caste certificates. 4. Merit-based selection. 5. Join coaching after selection letter.
documents: Caste certificate (SC/OBC), Income certificate, Educational certificates, Aadhaar card, Photograph

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
description: Rural road connectivity programme to provide all-weather road access to unconnected rural habitations.
eligibility: This is a government infrastructure scheme - benefits all residents of rural areas getting road connectivity. Habitations with population 500 and above in plain areas, 250 and above in hilly/tribal/desert areas.
benefits: All-weather road connection to previously unconnected villages. Access to markets, hospitals, schools. Employment during road construction. Better connectivity improves access to all government services and markets for farmers.
how_to_apply: Community-level benefit - no individual application. Village/Panchayat can raise demand through Block Development Officer if road connectivity is lacking.
documents: Village/community level - Gram Panchayat submits proposal

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Digital literacy programme to make 6 crore rural households digitally literate to use computers, smartphones and internet for everyday tasks.
eligibility: Rural household members who are digitally illiterate. Priority to SC/ST, minorities, women, differently abled persons, and BPL families. Age 14-60 years. One person per rural household.
benefits: Free 20-hour digital literacy training. Training in computer/smartphone basics, internet use, email, digital payments, online services, social media, cybersecurity. Certificate provided. Can access e-government services after training.
how_to_apply: 1. Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Registration via pmgdisha.in or CSC. 3. Training conducted near your home or at CSC. 4. Assessment done online. 5. Certificate issued on passing.
documents: Aadhaar card, Mobile number, Photograph

name: National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-NRLM) - Self Help Groups
description: Mission to reduce rural poverty by enabling poor households to access livelihood enhancements and financial services through Self Help Groups.
eligibility: Rural BPL women. Prioritize those excluded from financial services. 10-20 women form a Self Help Group. Regular savings and internal lending within group. Groups affiliated to SHG federations.
benefits: Community Investment Fund (CIF): Rs 50000-150000 per SHG as revolving fund. Bank linkage: collateral-free loans at low interest. Interest subvention: 7% effective interest for prompt repayers. Livelihood skill training. Market linkage for products.
how_to_apply: 1. Form a group of 10-15 rural women. 2. Contact nearest NRLM block office or Gram Panchayat. 3. Register SHG with NRLM district project manager. 4. Open SHG bank account. 5. Start regular savings. 6. Eligible for benefits after 6 months of regular functioning.
documents: Members' Aadhaar cards, BPL cards, Savings register, SHG meeting minutes book, Bank account in SHG name

name: PM Street Vendor AtmaNirbhar Nidhi - SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Working capital loan scheme for urban street vendors to resume livelihoods and graduate to formal financial systems.
eligibility: Urban street vendors and hawkers with vending certificate from ULB or LoR from ULB. Must have been vending before March 24, 2020. Any urban street vendor selling vegetables, fruits, food items, garments, footwear, etc.
benefits: Loan of Rs 10000 initially, upgradeable to Rs 20000 and Rs 50000. 7% annual interest subsidy. Rs 1200 annual incentive for digital transactions. No collateral. Microfinance or bank disbursement.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in. 2. Get LoR from local municipality. 3. Apply through bank/NBFC/MFI. 4. Loan disbursed to bank account.
documents: Aadhaar card, Certificate of Vending or municipality letter, Bank account

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - NULM (National Urban Livelihoods Mission)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Scheme to reduce poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households through skill development, self-employment and institutional support.
eligibility: Urban poor and homeless individuals. Self Help Groups in urban areas. Urban street vendors. Women in urban areas. Slum dwellers. Annual income below Rs 1.5 lakh approximately.
benefits: Social Mobilisation and Institution Development. Interest subsidy on Self Employment Programme loans (7% subvention). Skill training and certification under PMKVY. Shelter for urban homeless. Support for street vendors.
how_to_apply: 1. Contact nearest Urban Local Body (municipality/municipal corporation). 2. Approach NULM district office. 3. Join or form Urban SHG. 4. Apply for skill training or loan as applicable.
documents: Aadhaar card, Residence proof, BPL card if available, Income certificate

name: PM Vishwakarma - Toolkit Incentive
description: Financial support to traditional artisans for purchase of modern tools to improve quality and productivity.
eligibility: Same as PM Vishwakarma scheme - 18 traditional trades. Must be registered on PM Vishwakarma portal. Must complete basic skills training first.
benefits: Rs 15000 e-voucher for purchase of modern toolkits specific to their trade. Can be used at empanelled vendors. Tools to improve efficiency and product quality.
how_to_apply: Part of PM Vishwakarma registration. Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in, complete skill training, then toolkit voucher is issued.
documents: PM Vishwakarma registration number, Aadhaar card

name: Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (Construction Workers Pension)
description: Pension and welfare benefits for registered construction workers through Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act.
eligibility: Construction workers who have registered with state BOCW welfare board. Must have worked in construction for at least 90 days in past year. Age 18-60. Includes masons, electricians, painters, plumbers, carpenters, helpers.
benefits: Monthly pension Rs 1000-3000 (varies by state) after age 60. Death benefit Rs 1-2 lakh. Maternity benefit for female workers. Educational scholarships for children. Medical expenses reimbursement. Marriage assistance.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at state BOCW board office or their website. 2. Pay nominal registration fee. 3. Annual renewal of registration with proof of construction work. 4. Apply for specific benefits as needed.
documents: Aadhaar card, Age proof, Proof of construction work (wage slip, employer certificate), Bank account, Photograph

name: Pradhan Mantri Yuva Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan (PM-YUVA)
description: Mentorship and training programme for aspiring young entrepreneurs to provide business training, mentorship and handholding support.
eligibility: Indian youth aged 18-35. Must be Class 10 pass. Aspiring entrepreneurs or those who have started business within last 3 years. Not currently employed in government. Income below Rs 8 lakh annually.
benefits: Business development training. Online/classroom course. Mentorship from experienced entrepreneurs and SCORE mentors. Rs 7500 monthly stipend during 6-month classroom training. Access to MSME ecosystem.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at startupindia.gov.in or msde.gov.in when application window opens. 2. Fill application with business idea. 3. Shortlisted candidates attend selection process. 4. Training at selected education institutions.
documents: Aadhaar card, Educational certificates, Income proof, Business plan if any

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Loans
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Concessional loans and financial assistance to persons with disabilities for self-employment and livelihood activities.
eligibility: Persons with disability as certified under RPWD Act 2016. Disability 40% and above. Age 18-55. Income below Rs 3 lakh per annum. For skill development scheme: income up to Rs 6 lakh.
benefits: Loans up to Rs 25 lakh at 5% interest (women PWD at 4%). Loans for business, education, agricultural activities. Skill development assistance. 15% subsidy on term loans.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply through state channelizing agencies (SCAs) like state handicapped finance corporations. 2. Apply at nhfdc.nic.in. 3. Submit business plan and disability certificate. 4. Channel agency verifies and forwards. 5. Loan sanctioned by NHFDC.
documents: Disability certificate (UDID card), Income certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank account, Project report, 2 passport photographs

name: UDID - Unique Disability ID Card
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Unique Disability ID card to bring transparency and efficiency in services provided to persons with disabilities.
eligibility: All persons with specified disabilities under RPWD Act 2016 including visual impairment, hearing impairment, locomotor disability, intellectual disability, mental illness and others. Must be assessed by government medical authority.
benefits: Single identity for accessing all disability benefits and welfare schemes. Recognised across all states. E-UDID card on DigiLocker. Free bus pass in many states. Priority in government services. Easy access to all disability entitlements.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply online at swavlambancard.gov.in. 2. Or apply at District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC). 3. Schedule medical examination. 4. Medical board assesses disability type and percentage. 5. UDID card issued after assessment.
documents: Aadhaar card, Medical records of disability, Photograph, Doctor's certificate

name: Widow Remarriage and Support Scheme (Vidhwa Vivah Yojana) - Varies by State
description: Financial assistance to widows for their marriage and livelihood support. Various central and state schemes support widows.
eligibility: Widow women. For Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension: BPL widow aged 40-79 (Rs 300/month) and 80+ (Rs 500/month). State schemes vary. Widow remarriage incentive in some states Rs 10000-50000.
benefits: Monthly widow pension Rs 300-2000 (central + state combined). One-time marriage assistance for widows. Priority in housing schemes. Free education for children. Food security support.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply for widow pension at Gram Panchayat or Ward office under NSAP. 2. Submit death certificate of husband. 3. Verify widow status. 4. Pension starts after approval.
documents: Husband's death certificate, Aadhaar card, Marriage certificate, Bank account, BPL card, Photograph, Age proof

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Targeted Public Distribution System for the poorest of the poor families providing subsidised food grains at very low prices.
eligibility: Poorest of the poor households identified by state governments. Includes landless agricultural labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans/craftsmen, slum dwellers, daily-rated workers, destitute and old aged persons, widow-headed households, disabled-headed households.
benefits: 35 kg of food grains per family per month. Rice at Rs 3 per kg, wheat at Rs 2 per kg, coarse grain at Rs 1 per kg. Under PMGKAY these are now free. Distinct AAY ration card (yellow in most states).
how_to_apply: 1. Contact district food and civil supplies office. 2. Submit application with BPL proof. 3. Village/Ward surveyor verifies eligibility. 4. AAY card issued if most poor household. 5. Collect ration from nearest fair price shop.
documents: Any ID proof, Address proof, Income proof, Residence certificate from village/ward, BPL status proof

name: PM POSHAN - Anganwadi Nutrition Programme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-up for children under 6 years and pregnant/lactating women through Anganwadi centres.
eligibility: Children aged 6 months to 6 years. Pregnant women. Lactating mothers (up to 6 months after delivery). Adolescent girls in backward areas. Available at all Anganwadi centres.
benefits: Supplementary nutrition (hot cooked food and THR). Growth monitoring. Immunisation. Health check-up. Referral services. Pre-school non-formal education for 3-6 year olds. Nutrition and health education.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Anganwadi centre. Register your child/pregnancy with Anganwadi worker (AWW). Attend centre regularly for benefits. Free services.
documents: Birth certificate of child, Aadhaar card, Pregnancy card for mothers

name: PM SVANidhi - Digital Transaction Incentive for Vendors
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Incentive scheme for street vendors to adopt digital payments and graduate to formal financial systems.
eligibility: Street vendors registered on PM SVANidhi portal. Must have taken working capital loan under PM SVANidhi. Urban street vendors.
benefits: Rs 1 per digital transaction cashback up to 100 transactions per month (Rs 1200 per year). Interest subsidy. Financial literacy training. Credit score improvement.
how_to_apply: First enroll in PM SVANidhi loan scheme. Install UPI/payment app. Transactions automatically tracked. Incentive credited quarterly.
documents: PM SVANidhi registration, Bank account with UPI

name: Old Age Homes - Ministry of Social Justice
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Maintenance of senior citizens' homes by NGOs with government grant for destitute and needy senior citizens.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above. Preferably destitute, homeless, without family support. Income below Rs 2 lakh annually. Priority to women, disabled senior citizens.
benefits: Free residential accommodation. Food and nutrition. Medical care. Recreational facilities. Counselling and emotional support. Physiotherapy. Transportation for medical visits.
how_to_apply: 1. Contact nearest government-run or NGO-run old age home. 2. Apply at district social welfare office. 3. Submit age proof and income declaration. 4. Verification by social worker. 5. Admission subject to availability.
documents: Age proof, Income declaration, Address proof, Medical certificate, Aadhaar card, No family support declaration

name: National AIDS Control Programme - Free ART Treatment
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) and comprehensive care for people living with HIV/AIDS through government centres.
eligibility: All HIV positive individuals regardless of income. Free treatment available at ART centres in government hospitals. Pregnant women with HIV get special services.
benefits: Completely free ART medicines. Free CD4 and viral load testing. Regular monitoring and follow-up. Nutritional support. Psychological counselling. Opportunistic infection treatment. PPTCT for pregnant women.
how_to_apply: 1. Get HIV test at ICTC (Integrated Counselling and Testing Centre) in any government hospital. 2. If positive, referred to ART centre. 3. Registration at ART centre. 4. Free treatment started. 5. Lifelong free medicines.
documents: HIV positive test report, Aadhaar card, Address proof. Confidentiality maintained.

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) - Farmer Pension
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers to provide assured monthly pension after age 60.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with up to 2 hectares of cultivable land. Aged 18-40 years at entry. Not covered under any other pension scheme. Not income tax payer. Not enrolled in EPFO/ESIC/NPS.
benefits: Rs 3000 per month pension after age 60. Spouse gets Rs 1500/month as family pension on farmer's death. Government matches farmer's contribution equally. Monthly contribution: Rs 55-200 depending on age at enrollment.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit nearest CSC or PM Kisan portal. 2. Enroll with Aadhaar and bank account. 3. Choose pension scheme. 4. Set up auto-debit for monthly contribution. 5. Start receiving pension at age 60.
documents: Aadhaar card, Bank account, Land records, Mobile number

name: Chief Minister's Relief Fund / State Disaster Relief
description: Emergency financial assistance to individuals and families affected by natural calamities like floods, cyclone, drought, fire accidents.
eligibility: Families affected by natural disasters: floods, earthquake, drought, cyclone, hailstorm, landslide, fire. BPL and economically weak families. Loss of life, livestock, crops, or house.
benefits: Immediate relief: Rs 1 lakh-4 lakh for death in family. House damage: Rs 50000-1.5 lakh. Crop damage: Rs 6800 per hectare approx. Livestock loss: Rs 2000-30000 per animal. Varies by state and SDRF norms.
how_to_apply: 1. Report damage to Tahsildar/Block officer/Gram Panchayat. 2. Girdawari (survey) done by patwari. 3. Damage report submitted to district. 4. Compensation released by district authority. 5. CM Relief Fund: Apply directly at state CM relief fund portal.
documents: FIR for fire accidents, Patwari survey report, Death certificate if applicable, Land/house ownership proof, Bank account, Aadhaar card

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
description: Pension scheme exclusively for senior citizens providing assured return and monthly pension through LIC of India.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above. Indian citizens. Investment made through LIC. No maximum age limit. Individuals (not joint).
benefits: Assured return of 7.4% per annum. Monthly pension of Rs 1000-9250 depending on investment. Maximum investment Rs 15 lakh per senior citizen. Policy term 10 years. Loan up to 75% of purchase price after 3 years.
how_to_apply: 1. Visit LIC office or licindia.in. 2. Fill PMVVY application. 3. Invest lump sum (Rs 1.62 lakh minimum for Rs 1000/month pension). 4. Policy document issued. 5. Monthly pension credited from next month.
documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Bank account, Age proof, Photograph

name: Textiles Committee Schemes for Weavers
description: Comprehensive welfare and development schemes for handloom weavers and handicraft artisans.
eligibility: Handloom weavers registered with state handloom department or Weavers Service Centre. Small handloom units. Members of Primary Weavers Cooperative Societies.
benefits: Health Insurance: Rs 1500/year premium free for weaver and family. Life insurance Rs 2 lakh. Thrift Fund contribution. Credit at subsidised rates. Tool kit support. Design training at Weavers Service Centres. Market linkage through government exhibitions.
how_to_apply: 1. Register at nearest Weavers Service Centre. 2. Join Primary Weavers Cooperative Society. 3. Apply for individual schemes at Handloom Commissioner office or handlooms.gov.in.
documents: Weaver's identity card, Aadhaar card, Bank account, Proof of weaving work, Cooperative membership

name: Fishermen Welfare Scheme - PMMSY
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana providing comprehensive support to fishermen for infrastructure, insurance and livelihood enhancement.
eligibility: Active fishermen. Fish farmers. Fishing vessel owners. Members of fisheries cooperative. Must be registered with state fisheries department. Marine or inland fishermen.
benefits: Group Accident Insurance: Rs 5 lakh for accidental death/disability, Rs 2.5 lakh for partial disability. Saving cum Relief: Rs 1500 during lean season (ban period). Financial assistance for fishing vessels. Net and equipment subsidy 50% of cost.
how_to_apply: 1. Register with state fisheries department. 2. Apply at district fisheries office or fisheries.gov.in/pmmsy. 3. Join fishermen cooperative. 4. Submit fishing activity proof. 5. Insurance automatically enrolled.
documents: Fishing license, Aadhaar card, Bank account, Boat registration if applicable, Fishermen cooperative membership, Photograph

name: PM Aadhar-Linked Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarships for students with disabilities to encourage education and reduce dropout rate.
eligibility: Students with disability of 40% or more. Pre-matric: Class 9-10. Post-matric: Class 11 onwards including professional courses. Parental income below Rs 2.5 lakh for pre-matric and Rs 2.5 lakh for post-matric. Fresh and renewal students both eligible.
benefits: Pre-matric (Class 9-10): Rs 750-1000 per month + books and stationery Rs 2000/year. Post-matric: maintenance allowance Rs 1500-3000/month + course fee. Hostel allowance extra.
how_to_apply: 1. Apply at scholarships.gov.in. 2. Select appropriate scholarship scheme. 3. Upload disability certificate, income proof, mark sheets. 4. Institution verifies. 5. Scholarship credited to bank account.
documents: UDID disability certificate, Income certificate, Previous class mark sheets, Aadhaar card, Bank account, Admission proof
